blocks.text: BTS and Enhypen emerged as the big winners on the first night of the 2026 MAMA Awards, respectively taking home the Artist of the Year and Fans’ Choice of the Year accolades. The K-pop groups, which won two of the award program’s top prizes, were honored during the ceremony held at Kyocera Dome Osaka in Japan on Friday, Nov. 20. The BTS members, who are currently staging their “Arirang” concert in Taiwan, expressed their gratitude for the award through a recorded acceptance speech. “Thank you so much ARMY!” Jin exclaimed in Korean.
